children: edgeX is bringing its full suite of 150+ perpetual markets to the Arc network, expanding derivatives coverage across the ecosystem by 16 Sep 2026. The deployment moves the exchange's complete perp market lineup on-chain on Arc, extending the range of tradable derivatives available to users there.

The integration materially expands on-chain derivatives coverage on Arc from the listed date. Traders gain access to the same breadth of perpetual markets that edgeX offers elsewhere, without needing a separate venue for the additional listings. For holders of ARC and EDGE, the deployment creates a concrete usage and fee-flow channel, since trading activity that migrates onto Arc generates settlement and protocol fee flow tied to both networks. The scale of the rollout, covering the full market suite rather than a partial selection, means the coverage shift is immediate and measurable once live. Actual impact on activity will depend on how much perp volume moves to Arc after deployment.
